member.name: T:Emgu.CV.Image`2
member.summary: An image whose pixels have the color type (Gray, Bgr, ...) and the channel depth (byte, float, ...). The pixels are stored in as [row, column, channel], so the pixel at (x, y) is Data[y, x, channel].
member.remarks: This is a pure C# implementation of the Emgu CV Image class with the same names, signatures and results, but without native OpenCV. Unlike Emgu CV, the rows of are never padded, so Data.GetLength(1) always equals . The arithmetic methods and operators work element by element, and their results are saturated (for example, for byte images 200 + 100 = 255 and 100 - 200 = 0).
